name: The Trogg Threat
summary: At Loch Modan’s Southern Gate, Captain Rugelfuss faces a growing trogg threat with too few defenders. The Ironforge Reserve has been called away to support Alliance battlefronts, leaving the remaining garrison stretched thin. Rugelfuss asks travelers to thin the troggs in the hills and bring back their stone teeth.

sections.title: A Depleted Frontier
sections.body: Captain Rugelfuss guards Loch Modan’s southern approach with only a small garrison. The dwarven mountaineers and Ironforge Reserve have been sent to reinforce Alliance battlefronts, leaving the Southern Gate guard tower short of troops. Rugelfuss is under strict orders to hold the gate, so he cannot lead an attack into the highlands. Nearby settlers and travelers remain exposed to ambushes.

sections.title: Stemming the Tide
sections.body: Troggs in the nearby crags threaten Khaz Modan, and their numbers grow quickly when left unchecked. They could overrun dwarven outposts. To buy time and thin their ranks, Rugelfuss asks travelers to strike at the troggs in their hillside warrens and bring back their stone teeth as proof.

faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss is a dwarven military officer at Loch Modan’s Southern Gate guard tower. He must secure the pass against intruders despite his small garrison.

faq.q: Why is the Southern Gate understaffed?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Reserve has been sent to fight on distant Alliance battlefronts. Only a small force remains at the gate, bound to its defensive post and unable to strike back.
Trogg Stone Teeth are the troggs’ naturally petrified, stone-like teeth, reflecting their subterranean, earthen heritage. Rugelfuss requires them as proof that troggs have been slain.

aliases: where are troggs for this quest
faq.answer: Troggs live in the rocky hills, ravines, and excavation sites beside the road near Loch Modan’s Southern Gate.

faq.q: Why are the troggs such a threat right now?
faq.answer: Troggs multiply quickly and attack violently to defend their territory. With troops diverted, they can overrun inhabited lands and threaten the passes linking Loch Modan to neighboring territories.

faq.q: How does completing this quest aid King Magni Bronzebeard?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard is responsible for the safety of all Khaz Modan. Thinning the troggs while Ironforge’s armies fight abroad helps protect internal supply lines and vulnerable frontier settlements.

angles.text: As a dwarf, thinning the troggs near the Southern Gate is a direct duty to Khaz Modan, and King Magni Bronzebeard himself will praise you for it.
As an Alliance member, you see how commitments in distant lands have left local garrisons like Loch Modan without their defensive reserves.
